Measuring sour cream

A cup of sour cream weighs about 230 g. Full-fat, light and Greek-style sour cream all land in the same range. Plain yogurt is a common substitute and weighs nearly the same per cup.

Thick ingredients like sour cream should go in a dry measuring cup, the kind you level off, not a liquid cup. Spoon it in, press out air pockets and scrape the top flat. Or skip the cup and spoon it straight into the bowl on a scale.

Source: USDA FoodData Central (230 g per cup).

Questions

How many grams is ½ cup of sour cream?

½ cup of sour cream weighs about 115 g (4.06 oz). A full cup is 230 g.

How many cups is 100 grams of sour cream?

100 g of sour cream is about ⅜ cup, based on 230 g per cup.

Can I substitute yogurt for sour cream by weight?

Yes. Plain yogurt and sour cream weigh nearly the same per cup (around 230 g), so they swap gram for gram. Greek yogurt is the closest match in thickness.
